theater_main_quest_02_11_02_109:
I've decided, Marius!
Very well, then—I shall march on Orario myself!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_111: Huh? What, are you going sightseeing?
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_112:
Don't be absurd! To turn the tide, we'll kidnap
a god who lives in Orario! A god as a hostage—
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_116: No, a god as a god-stage—
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_118:
And force those Orario fools to surrender!
Bwahahaha! What a flawless plan!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_119:
No, that's insane!
How would we even get into Orario—
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_121:
Now, Mariuuus!
Gather our finest and follow me!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_122:
Onward!
To snatch ourselves a god~~~!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_124:
W-wait a minuuuute?!
You haven't even decided who to target?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_02_125:
How thick is that skull of yours, you
muscle-headed MORON?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_007:
Lord Miach, Lady Hephaistos.
Um, have you seen my goddess anywhere?
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_009:
Hestia?
Hmm, my apologies, Bell. I haven't seen her.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_011:
I see... Thank you very much.
...Well, I'll be going, then...
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_013:
Bell. If you're not in a hurry,
I'd be glad to lend an ear.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_015:
It's written all over your face.
Something happened, didn't it?
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_017: It's not really something to talk about, but...
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_018:
Um... Do gods ever... fall in love
with those of us in the mortal world?
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_019: As a lover, or a partner for life...
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_021:
They do, I'd say.
If anything, we're drawn to you children
more easily than to anyone.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_024:
...That's right. Favor, whim, motherly love,
fatherly love. Love takes many forms,
but there's no doubt we fall for you.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_026: Plain old romantic feelings included, of course.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_028:
B-but we're talking about gods and us!
...We're completely different.
Our station, our very existence—
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_030:
Even, um...
the time we have to live...
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_031: What is it you're afraid of, Bell?
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_033:
It's true, Bell, that our love is but a moment.
Even if, for you, it may span a lifetime.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_034:
If a god ever confesses to you,
face her properly. Even if there's someone
else you have feelings for.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_036:
You needn't be swept along by a god's
selfishness. Simply face her sincerely—
that is all it takes.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_038:
I'm sure most gods would accept that much.
So please... don't run from a god's love.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_040:
You may turn her down, or you may accept.
Only, please, don't be afraid.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_044:
Coward!! Blockhead!!
You clueless bunny-brained dolt~~!!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_045: You respect gods way too much, Bell!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_046:
I mean, I'm happy you respect me...!
But you could loosen up a little more~!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_048:
Hm...?
Boss from the potato puff stand?
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_051:
...So why do I have to go fetch the
Jyaga Maru-kun ingredients for you, Boss?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_055:
We need one more sack for the stall on the
main street. Well, I'm counting on you!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_057:
...Jeez, I'm a god, you know?
Nngh, doesn't he know I can't just go
wandering outside Orario on my own?
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_059:
Ugh~. Looks like it's gonna rain, too.
But no ingredients means no Jyaga Maru-kun...
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_066:
How about that, Marius?!
A perfect disguise, is it not?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_070: "Disguise"? You just threw on a robe!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_074:
Thanks, Ganesha. Lucky for me you're
the one in charge of the gate.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_075:
Think nothing of it! Jyaga Maru-kun is a
lump of pure energy that enriches our city.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_076:
If you go to fetch its ingredients, then
god or not, I have no choice but to allow it!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_093:
Thank you so much.
For listening to me and everything...
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_095: I hope I was of at least some help.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_096:
Yes. But to be honest—
I still don't know what I should do.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_098: First things first: find Hestia and make up.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_101: Maybe she's already back at home...
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_110:
Th-the goddess was kidnapped?!
Is that true...?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_111:
—Yeah. All thanks to some masked moron
who happily waved her out the gate.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_113: Now's when ya oughta be shoutin' it, ya idiot!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_117: Finn, what about a pursuit team?
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_118:
Not yet. The enemy split into several units
and is scattering as they move.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_119:
Meanin' we got no clue which one's got
Itty-Bitty. Plus there's mountains to cross.
Chase 'em sloppy, and we'll end up lost!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_121:
It's embarrassing to admit, but they know
the terrain outside Orario better than we do.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_124:
Hold up, Ais-tan.
No need to go outta yer way for Itty-Bitty—
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_125: But someone has to go after them.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_126: All right, Ais. I'll leave it to you.
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_129:
Kid, were ya even listenin'?
Ais is goin'. Ya plannin' to slow her down?
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_130:
...I'm...! I'm the goddess's—Lady Hestia's
follower!! So please...let me go!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_133:
Still, if we chase blindly, their main force
will escape. If only we could be certain which
unit has Lady Hestia...
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_135: Why not leave that part to me?
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_138: You just need to find where Hestia is, right?
theater_main_quest_02_11_03_140:
Sure. With our very own—
Perseus, Asfi, on the job!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_001:
Hey, Ares! Put me down already!
You think you'll get away with this~~~?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_003:
Hah! As if I'd put you down!
Even a runt goddess like you is our
precious god-stage!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_005: WHO ARE YOU CALLING A RUNT?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_010:
Ngh... Since when does Orario
rule the skies, too...?!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_011: ...The rest is up to you, Sword Princess.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_012:
Bah! As if I'll let one measly adventurer
get in my way!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_014: I am Ares, patron god of the Kingdom of Rakia!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_015: Behold the swordsmanship of the god of war!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_024:
Archers! Aim for that woman!
Capture her, and Orario's adventurers
won't be able to follow us!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_025: Hey, Marius! Don't go giving orders yourself!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_028:
Just use this opening to get out
of here already, you muscle-brain!!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_053:
The village chief's house, in a mountain
village. We got swept away by the river, and
Ms. Ais rescued us—
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_057:
She went to check outside the village.
She said Lord Ares's army might still
be nearby.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_059:
Haah... I'm sorry, Bell.
I got you into a real mess.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_065:
Oh, Mr. Calm!
She just woke up.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_068: You're the village chief? Thanks for having us!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_071:
Sorry, but we'd like to stay a little longer.
Would that be okay?
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_072:
Of course. Please make yourselves at home.
And feel free to call on my daughter,
Rina, anytime.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_079:
She woke up once and is sleeping again.
So, how was it?
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_081:
No Rakian soldiers, and no Asfi either...
Just signs of a fight.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_084:
I don't know...
But I think we shouldn't move carelessly.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_085:
...Wha?!
O-oh, let's stay a little longer, then!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_104: I'm really sorry about this, Bell.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_105: We promised not to say that, remember?
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_107: Yes. Everyone's so kind and warm.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_116:
Tonight there's a village festival
to pray for a good harvest.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_117:
The rain's finally stopped, too...
so everyone's really fired up.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_119:
Bell... Why don't you go help them
get ready for the festival?
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_120: But will you be all right, Goddess?
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_121:
They've done so much for us—doing nothing
would be a disgrace to the Hestia Familia...
Please, Bell.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_123: Got it. I'll be off, then.
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_127:
They told me this would suit me, but...
Is it...weird...?
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_129:
N-no, not at all!
It looks great on you!
theater_main_quest_02_11_04_131: Yes. To help with the village festival.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_006: All right! That's the last of it.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_007: I'll ask for your help again later.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_011: That there... is a scale from Lord Black Dragon.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_013:
It's no fairy tale. The Black Dragon truly
exists in this world. The Three Great Quests
have yet to be completed.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_014: This is a scale from the "Black Dragon"?
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_015:
Yep! Long, long ago, when the hero drove it out
of Orario and it flew off north, a chipped scale
fell on this village, or so they say.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_016:
Big ones, little ones... The village must
have about ten of 'em, I'd say.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_017:
Thing is, the reason monsters never
attack this village is thanks to these scales.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_019:
They're scales from Lord Black Dragon, after
all. Most monsters get the jitters.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_020:
We get to live in peace like this thanks to
them. ...Mind you, it's a bit odd,
worshipping a monster.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_022:
But the ones who protect us and keep us alive
aren't adventurers or gods... It's these scales.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_023:
(The one-eyed dragon from the hero stories—
a dragon that might destroy the world...
is protecting a village?)
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_025:
But someday, if Lord Black Dragon
gets slain... what'll we do, I wonder...
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_026: We'd probably still pray to 'em, I reckon.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_030: It's almost like it's a god.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_040:
! Whoa.
Mr. Calm, is something wrong?
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_041:
Ah, Bell.
...Might you spare this old man a little time?
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_043:
You hold your goddess dear with all
your heart, don't you, Bell?
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_044:
Yes... Of course I do.
She took me in when I had nowhere to go.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_046:
..................
Bell. Do you know what this is?
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_048:
Long ago, I was a follower of a certain goddess.
I adored her, and she loved me in return.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_050: We swore our love to each other.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_059:
I was saved, and by chance I survived...
but she was sent back to the heavens.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_060: Time and again, I thought of following her.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_061:
But I couldn't throw away the life she saved.
I came to this village, and I've lived here
ever since without taking a wife.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_063:
She's adopted. A village child with no family
that I took in. Rina is my pillar of support.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_067:
Mr. Calm?! Are you all right?!
I'll go get Rina—
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_068:
—There's no need to worry.
I know my own body better than anyone.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_070:
Bell... Please, treasure her.
Treasure your goddess.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_073:
Think of it as a dying man's ramblings if you
like. But you mustn't live with regret, as I
have.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_077:
The sluggishness is mostly gone now.
But if I stay in bed, Bell takes care of me~.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_079: Maybe just a little longer like this—
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_084:
Valen-what's-her-name...?!
Nngh... What do you want?
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_088: He said he had to talk to the village chief...
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_090:
What's-her-name. I never thanked you
for saving us. Really, thank you for that.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_094:
—Now, down to business.
What do you think of my Bell?!
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_096:
Y-you know! There's gotta be something...
Like, an impression or whatever!
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_103: I knew I could count on you!!
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_104:
Just don't go doting on him too much.
Rabbits get carried away pretty easily!
Ehehe!
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_112:
Yep, good as new! It's a festival today, right?
I'm gonna enjoy myself too!
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_115:
All riiight!
The goddess is here, so let's start
the harvest dance!
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_119:
If the girl accepts, they're officially a
couple!
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_121: If you'd like, would you dance too, goddess?
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_123:
Oh, that's it!
If a goddess dances for us, we're sure
to get a great harvest!
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_125: Haha, okay, okay, I get it.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_126: ...Is Lady Hestia a goddess of the harvest...?
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_127: No, I'm pretty sure she isn't...
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_128:
Ahem, Bell?
It seems I suddenly have to fulfill
my duties as a goddess...
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_129:
If you ask me to dance with you... well,
I'll let that thing from before slide.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_131:
Y-you know! The thing that made me storm
out of our home!
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_133:
If a certain wonderful goddess confessed
her love to you one day... what would you say?
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_135:
Bell... Please, treasure her.
Treasure your goddess.
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_142: Go on, kid! Don't embarrass the goddess!
theater_main_quest_02_12_05_145: ...W-would you please dance with me, Goddess?
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_001:
(Of course I respect the goddess.
She means more to me than anything.)
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_004: (How much longer can she and I be together?)
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_006: You mustn't live with regret... as I have...
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_017:
Don't be so formal, Calm.
After all you did for us? Call, and I'll come
running.
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_018:
..................
When I saw you, I remembered
my patron goddess, Lady Brigid...
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_020:
Brigid, you say?
You mean blond hair, bright red eyes...
that Brigid?
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_022:
Yeah. Brigid and I are god-pals!
We hung out all the time in the heavens,
and fought plenty too!
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_024:
I see... She was a kind soul...
She treated everyone alike,
and she loved someone like me.
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_026:
Brigid did?!
Calm, you've been tricked!
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_027:
Whenever she's about to lose an argument,
she makes fun of me for being short!
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_028: I bet she was on her best behavior around you!
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_029:
Ha, haha... Is that so?
I never noticed...
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_031:
Goddess, please tell me...
When I return to the heavens...
will I be able to see her?
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_033:
...I'm sure Brigid will find you.
That girl is persistent.
theater_main_quest_02_12_06_034:
I'm scared... Of not meeting her,
and of meeting her...
I'm scared...
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_001: So this is where you were.
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_057:
Do you think Mr. Calm will get to meet
Lady Brigid...?
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_004:
Souls that return to the heavens are wiped
clean. They forget everything and come back
down to the mortal world.
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_006:
So after all... gods and you children
shouldn't swear love to each other.
—Is that what you're thinking?
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_008:
We'll... eventually be gone,
long before you—
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_009:
Bell, you know the pain of being
the one left behind, don't you?
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_011:
When Grandpa died... I was so sad that
no amount of crying was ever enough.
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_012:
For us, there's an end.
Someday we get to forget everything.
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_014:
But gods are eternal.
Carrying that pain forever is just—
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_016:
Don't think about it so hard.
We gods—
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_021:
We gods and you children might not be able
to live in the same time. But I'll always
be right by your side.
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_024:
No matter how old you get, even when you're
an old man. I'll be with you, always.
I'm never letting go.
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_027:
Even if death pulls us apart...
I'll come find you. I promise.
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_028:
Even if it takes hundreds, thousands,
tens of thousands of years... I'll find you
reborn, even when you're not Bell anymore.
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_031:
And I'll ask you: "Won't you become
my follower? Won't you join my Familia?"
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_033:
Mortal world or heavens, it doesn't matter.
Same goes for Brigid and Calm.
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_034: I'm gonna go meet you all over again.
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_035:
'Cause we're gods,
living for all eternity, you know?
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_036:
So don't be afraid, Bell.
Of loving us.
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_037:
Goddess...
I... I want to stay with you...!
theater_main_quest_02_12_07_038: I'll be with you forever, Bell.
theater_main_quest_03_01_01_031: F-forget that, do you have any potions?!
theater_main_quest_03_01_01_043:
We were looking for you.
When we got split up, I was worried—
glad you're safe.
theater_main_quest_03_01_01_044:
Going off alone on the 19th floor
is dangerous.
theater_main_quest_03_01_01_045:
Um, Master Bell...
Who might that be...?
theater_main_quest_03_01_01_046:
..................
Let's head back to the 18th floor for now, okay?
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_001:
So, Mr. Bell.
Who exactly is this person?
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_002:
Did you rescue yet another mystery woman,
trouble and all, again?
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_007:
Get away from her, Mr. Bell!
What on earth are you thinking?!
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_008:
Did you bring her because she has a pretty
face?!
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_009:
That would make you one of those
monster-lusting monster fetishists!
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_011:
Mr. Bell, a monster is a monster!
The enemy of humanity!
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_022:
Y... yeah.
That's my name, but...
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_023:
Bell... name...
Your name is Bell?
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_027:
...Master Bell. What happened
between you and her?
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_029:
Adventurers were chasing her, and monsters
attacked her too... She was trembling and
crying.
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_032:
If anyone finds out we're protecting a monster,
the Hestia Familia is finished!
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_033: Even so, I don't want to abandon her!
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_038:
What will you do now?
Take her back to the surface?
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_039:
Yes.
If she stays in the Dungeon, she'll just
get attacked again...
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_040:
I want to go home and hear
what the goddess thinks, too.
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_042: Yeah, let's go to our house, okay?
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_044:
A monster with intellect has made contact
with an adventurer. They'll exit Babel soon.
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_048:
What will you do? For better or worse,
the Hestia Familia draws far too much
of the city's attention.
theater_main_quest_03_01_02_050:
Whether the goddess Hestia's children
can become a hope for "them"... or not.
theater_main_quest_03_01_03_002: I-I've never heard of a talking monster!
theater_main_quest_03_01_03_005:
...Honestly, I don't know how
I'm supposed to take this either.
theater_main_quest_03_01_03_006: But she's so scared, how could I not?
theater_main_quest_03_01_03_008: Yeah, we'll keep her safe here for a while.
theater_main_quest_03_01_03_010: Hey, you. Do you have a name?
theater_main_quest_03_01_03_012:
No, no, that's my name.
What about you?
theater_main_quest_03_01_03_014: She doesn't have one after all...
theater_main_quest_03_01_03_015:
Her species would be "vouivre," I suppose...
but that's not a name of her own.
theater_main_quest_03_01_03_019:
You're the one who brought her here.
Take responsibility and name her.
theater_main_quest_03_01_03_023:
Master Bell...
